dataset.name: Lung squamous cell carcinoma (CPTAC-GDC, 2025)
dataset.description: Independent CPTAC lung squamous cell carcinoma cohort with GDC-derived bulk RNA-seq TPM and GDC survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: CPTAC lung squamous cell carcinoma; an external primary-tumor cohort generated from open GDC data and not pooled with TCGA-LUSC.

metadata.source_data_system: NCI GDC via the cBioPortal public API
metadata.redistribution_note: The cohort is analyzable in TCGA-TRACE, but raw matrix downloads remain disabled pending a dedicated redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: The source TPM profile is retained as raw non-negative TPM and transformed once as log2(TPM + 1). Overall-survival time is joined by immutable patient submitter ID from the current GDC survival endpoint because the cBioPortal clinical table omits follow-up time for most living participants.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same Entrez identifier are averaged sample-wise; different identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The cBioPortal GDC profile supplies non-negative TPM values. TCGA-TRACE applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Initial diagnosis as implemented by the GDC survival endpoint
